title: ExtractionAvailability
description: Whether memories can be extracted from Context Center documents and articles now, and why not when they cannot.

available.description: True when memories can be extracted now.

reason.description: Why memories cannot be extracted, present only when available is false. ExtractionDisabled: the LLM or memory extraction is turned off. ProviderDisabled: the AI provider that extracts memories is turned off. ProviderUnavailable: the AI provider that extracts memories is unavailable.
